premise: T. rex wishes he could fly up to the clouds like Pteranodon; he jumps and jumps; Turtle, who can't fly either, shows him the shapes in the clouds from the ground — one like Pteranodon, one like a little T. rex — and Pteranodon lands beside them to look too.
inspiration: Aesop's 'The Tortoise and the Birds' turned: nobody carries anyone up; the flyer comes down to share the sky from the ground.
lesson: You can reach the sky in more ways than one.

en-US.title: Up in the Clouds
en-US.text: {canvas:clouds 0.6} {sfx:breeze} [softly] High up in the sky, {pteranodon:enter} {pteranodon:go to sky} Pteranodon was floating near the clouds. {pteranodon:live glide} {trex:enter} T. rex watched her from the ground. {trex:face happy} "I want to fly up there too!" So he jumped. {trex:live jump} {sfx:thump} Thump. He jumped again. {trex:hop} Thump. [sighs] But his feet always came back down. {trex:face sad} "I'll never get up to the clouds," he said. Slowly, slowly, {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to trex} Turtle came crawling over. [gently] "I can't fly either," she said. "But I know a way. Lie back, and look up." So they lay in the soft ferns, side by side, {turtle:live look-around} and looked. "That cloud looks like an egg," said Turtle. {trex:face surprised} "That one looks like Pteranodon!" said T. rex. And that little one, with a big round head and teeny tiny arms… [laughs] "That one's ME!" {trex:face happy} {trex:wobble} {pteranodon:go to meadow} Pteranodon floated down and {pteranodon:go to trex by hop} landed right beside them. [curious] "What are you two doing?" [happily] "Flying," said T. rex. "With our eyes." {pteranodon:face happy} {all:face happy} So she lay down too. {turtle:hearts} Three friends on the ground, all up in the clouds.

es-ES.title: En las nubes
es-ES.text: {canvas:clouds 0.6} {sfx:breeze} [softly] Allá arriba, en el cielo, {pteranodon:enter} {pteranodon:go to sky} Pteranodon flotaba cerca de las nubes. {pteranodon:live glide} {trex:enter} T. rex la miraba desde el suelo. {trex:face happy} —¡Yo también quiero subir ahí! Así que saltó. {trex:live jump} {sfx:thump} Pum. Volvió a saltar. {trex:hop} Pum. [sighs] Pero los pies siempre le volvían al suelo. {trex:face sad} —Nunca llegaré a las nubes —dijo. Despacito, despacito, llegó {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to trex} Tortuga. [gently] —Yo tampoco sé volar —dijo—. Pero conozco un truco. Túmbate y mira hacia arriba. Así que se tumbaron entre los helechos blanditos, uno al lado del otro, {turtle:live look-around} y miraron. —Esa nube parece un huevo —dijo Tortuga. {trex:face surprised} —¡Y esa parece Pteranodon! —dijo T. rex. Y aquella pequeñita, con la cabeza grande y redonda y unos bracitos diminutos… [laughs] —¡Esa soy YO! {trex:face happy} {trex:wobble} {pteranodon:go to meadow} Pteranodon bajó flotando y {pteranodon:go to trex by hop} se posó justo a su lado. [curious] —¿Qué hacéis? [happily] —Volar —dijo T. rex—. Con los ojos. {pteranodon:face happy} {all:face happy} Así que ella también se tumbó. {turtle:hearts} Tres amigos en el suelo, y los tres en las nubes.
